body.title: Validate guidance completeness and review binding
body.summary: Add record validation in validate.ts using schema-first checks followed by domain, provenance, UI-type specimen and review invariants. Preserve authored values and return deterministic JSON Pointer issues; do not evaluate license policy or generate guidance.
acceptanceChecks: Missing provenance, applicability, required examples, domain payloads, measurable-check limits or explicit no-check rationale prevents admission.
Each declared UI type has example and misuse references; Color/Layout/Visual style conditional payloads are enforced together when applicable.
Draft/stale/incomplete review cannot pass publication checks; inferred authorship stays inferred.
All identity, version, relations, rationale and lineage fields survive validated JSON round-trip.

tests.name: record-validation.test.ts — completeness, authorship, conditional payloads and platform examples
record-roundtrip.test.ts — all sc1 fields preserved and review-staleness rejection
